title: CPH2583_16.0.10.501(EX01) is available
description:
New version: CPH2583_16.0.10.501(EX01)Home screen & Lock screen

• You can now use a 2-finger spread gesture on the Home screen to clear all app notification badges.

System tools

• You can now annotate images directly in Notes to highlight key points.

Camera & Photos

• Introducing AI Remix Collage, which lets you extract subjects from videos, save them as animated stickers, and apply them to videos, motion photos, or other still photos to create new motion photos or add animated outlines for more creative designs.

• Fixes an issue where some icons, text, and menus might remain in portrait mode when using Camera in landscape mode.

Security & privacy

• Improves virus protection by automatically blocking high-risk behaviors, such as the abuse of Accessibility services, keeping a record of detected events, and providing alerts to help protect your data. You can find this feature in "Phone Manager - Viruses & risks - Block suspicious app activities".

• Improves the experience of using hidden apps. While using a hidden app, you can swipe up from the bottom of the screen toward the floating window area in the upper-right corner to open it in a floating window.

• Integrates the August 2026 Android security patch to enhance system security.

Please do not turn off your device while the update is installing. During installation you cannot use your device at all, even to dial 9-1-1
